summary: The diff implements all four requirements with good coverage. REQ-1 (rental section on HomePage), REQ-2 (home delivery across HomePage, ProductCatalogPage, Footer), REQ-3 (authorized dealer badge on HomePage hero and BusinessProfilePage), and REQ-4 (rental badge on ProductCard) are all addressed. However, the build request specifies two required image assets that do not appear to have been added. The implementation uses Lucide icons instead of the specified image files.
